description:
Goal
Do the painful structural cutover: remove RuntimeValueLayout/RuntimeInputLayout/RuntimeLane as the artifact authority and replace them with a root-scoped transport spine plus fact tables keyed by ShapeId, ScalarId, and CallableId.

Required model
Shape = Nothing | Scalar(ScalarId) | Tuple(Vec<ShapeId>) | Callable(CallableId). ExecutableNeed remains only the coarse pre-spine seed. Divergence remains is_empty(return_ty). CallableId is the spine identity; target executable, capture lanes, local/direct status, boundary materialization, and codegen lanes are facts keyed by CallableId.

Strategy
Build the spine once from settled RuntimeDemand inside MaterializeRoot/transport planning. Every artifact rung carries ShapeId/TransportPlan references, not copied recursive layouts. Fact tables hold scalar ty/repr, tuple children, callable target/captures, executable return/input/resume/capture shapes, boundary ABI facts, and codegen lane facts.

No bridge rule
Do not keep a committed path that derives RuntimeValueLayout from Shape or Shape from RuntimeValueLayout. If this cannot compile atomically split-wise, it is one large commit.

Removal target
RuntimeValueLayout, RuntimeInputLayout, RuntimeLane, abi_reprs()/lane_tys() on recursive layout, runtime_value_layout_from_demand, runtime_input_layout_from_demand, local_callable_layout as a layout builder, boundary_return_abi over layout, and artifact fields named return_layout/resume_layouts/entry_capture_layouts/runtime_params when they carry layouts rather than shape refs.

Checks
All tests from fz-hwn.19.1 green; cargo check --all-targets; rg confirms RuntimeValueLayout/RuntimeInputLayout/RuntimeLane are gone outside historical docs or migration notes.
title: Transport spine: replace RuntimeValueLayout with ShapeId-backed transport facts in one cutover
